caption: The video captures an underwater side view of a swimmer moving horizontally beneath a dimly lit pool, arms stretched forward to the right while wearing black jammers and a cap. A green and yellow lane rope runs across the top, with bright wall lights behind and the swimmer’s mirrored image rippling on the surface. The legs cycle through a dolphin-kick pattern: held straight and together, bending at the knees as the feet swing downward and backward, then extending again. The torso and hips undulate slightly in phase with the leg motion, tilting the body line as the kick recovers. The surface reflection mirrors these bends and tilts, confirming it is the same swimmer rather than another person. The background lights shift leftward while the swimmer remains relatively centered in the frame, indicating camera tracking. A bubble trail remains near the lane rope behind the body.
